name: libxsmm-k-loop-consume-before-pointer-updates
hypothesis: Both supplied K loops have the same instruction order. Move their two pointer updates after the four FMOPA operations so computation immediately follows the operand loads. Preserve the paired loads, registers, FMOPA order, counter and 512 iterations. Under the wrapper's operand swap, z0/z1 contain B values and z2/z3 contain packed A values. This distinct scheduling change tests earlier operand consumption; no gain is established. All other code and the complete BSD notice remain unchanged. Assembly, correctness and performance are untested. Validation requires the fixed flags, 0.002 tolerance, general-size and boundary checks, and fresh repeated paired controls with power source and settings unchanged.
